title: Find why invoices disagree with finance (two root causes)
prompt:
Two complaints came in from finance about tally, the billing app in this repo.

1. Their hand-checked totals sometimes differ from ours by a cent. Example: they make order O00269 €20.87, `python3 -m tally invoice O00269` says €20.86. About one invoice in ten is affected.
2. Customer C0010 (gold tier) bought 120 units with coupon STAFF25 and was given 43% off a line. Company policy is that no line is ever discounted by more than 30%, whatever combination of rules applies.

Find the root causes and fix them in the code. Read docs/architecture.md for how money is supposed to work. Keep the existing tests passing, and don't change the sample data in data/.
